headline: SBI Securities releases its 11 Diwali stock picks for Samvat 2083
summary: SBI Securities has published a list of 11 recommended stocks for investors ahead of Samvat 2083. The list spans large and small companies, including Tata Steel, Indian Hotels, MCX, Jyoti CNC, Sky Gold, Genus Power, Power Mech Projects, Centum Electronics, Stylam Industries, Sambhv Steel, and Lumax Industries. Retail investors tracking brokerage reports can use this list for festive portfolio additions.

headline: Power Mech secures Rs 320 crore order from Vedanta Aluminium
summary: Power Mech Projects has bagged an end-to-end operation and maintenance contract worth Rs 320 crore from Vedanta Aluminium. The deal covers a 130 MW coal-fired cogeneration power plant and a 90 MW Blowout Preventer at Lanjigarh, Odisha. Despite the order win, Power Mech shares were trading under pressure. Indian retail investors tracking infrastructure and power service providers should note the company's order book additions.
whats_next: Quarterly earnings delivery on order execution
why_it_matters: Order book expands despite short-term stock pressure
winners_losers: Power Mech gains / shareholders face pressure
